result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with mature trees and detached housing. While a sidewalk exists on the left side, the environment lacks essential safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control signs.

hazards.name: Unmarked intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to define a safe crossing path for pedestrians and reduces driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of Glen Echo Rd and McCallum St

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located within the narrow sidewalk path, creating a physical barrier for pedestrians, especially those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the intersection corners creates a significant barrier for universal accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and mature trees near the intersection corners may limit sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection, particularly the left side

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly delineate pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection corners to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: This residential street features sidewalks on both sides, though the walkway on the right is significantly narrowed by overgrown vegetation. The environment lacks traffic calming, marked crossings, and clear lane organization, while the pavement shows signs of significant degradation.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction (Vegetation)
hazards.description: Overgrown shrubs and trees on the right side of the street encroach upon the sidewalk, reducing the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the property line.

hazards.name: Roadway Surface Degradation
hazards.description: The asphalt is heavily cracked and patched, creating an uneven surface for pedestrians crossing or using micro-mobility.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing
interventions.description: Trim back overgrown vegetation to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or chicanes to ensure low vehicle speeds on this residential block.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to provide a smooth and safe environment for all users.
